meta.name: jobs-to-be-done
meta.description: Discover what customers truly need by analyzing the "job" they hire your product to do. Use when the user mentions "customer discovery", "why customers churn", "what job does this solve", "competing against luck", "product-market fit", "switching behavior", "milkshake moment", or "functional vs emotional jobs". Also trigger when investigating why users choose competitors, designing features around real customer needs, or reframing a value proposition. Covers JTBD interviews, competition analysis, and jobs-oriented roadmaps. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For rapid validation, see design-sprint. For non-leading interview technique, see mom-test.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析客户雇佣产品的真实任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道客户为什么选择或放弃你的产品
copy.tagline_en: Analyze the real job customers hire your product for
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand why customers choose or leave your product

howto.what: 分析用户“雇佣”产品要完成的任务，输出任务陈述、四力模型、大小雇佣分析、非明显竞争图谱和客户发现访谈框架。
howto.when: 当用户提到“客户发现”、“为什么用户流失”、“产品市场匹配”、“奶昔时刻”等关键词，或要求分析竞争、设计功能、重构价值主张时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析用户为什么流失，用JTBD框架。
say.note: 输出四力模型和大小雇佣分析。

say.text: 写一个任务陈述：用户雇佣我的产品做什么？
say.note: 生成“当…我想…以便…”格式的陈述。

say.text: 我的产品有哪些非明显竞争对手？
say.note: 列出完成同一任务的不同类别方案。

howto.what_en: Analyze the 'job' customers hire a product to do, outputting job statements, four forces, big/little hire, non-obvious competition, and discovery interview framework.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions 'customer discovery', 'why customers churn', 'product-market fit', 'milkshake moment', etc., or asks to analyze competition, design features, or reframe value proposition.

say_en.text: Analyze why users churn using JTBD framework.
say_en.note: Outputs four forces and big/little hire analysis.

say_en.text: Write a job statement for what users hire my product to do.
say_en.note: Generates 'When... I want to... so I can...' format.

say_en.text: What are my product's non-obvious competitors?
say_en.note: Lists different categories solving the same job.
